senses.gloss_en: land use certificate (the red book proving ownership of land or a house)

examples.en: This house already has its land use certificate.

notes: Wiktionary gloss (synonym of sổ hộ khẩu) is wrong; sổ đỏ is the land use rights certificate. Rewritten from my own knowledge.

senses.gloss_en: to compete; to emulate (to try to outdo one another)

senses.gloss_en: emulation drive (organised competition to do better at work or school)

examples.en: I messaged you yesterday but you haven't replied yet.

senses.gloss_en: to adapt; to arrange (a piece of music, a story or a play)

notes: Wiktionary gloss was garbled ('antinationalist self-deprecating'); rewritten as self-abasing. Please verify the nuance; example constructed.
